purpose: NovelAI prompt token-budget counting. NovelAI has never published tokenizer weights for local use; legacy v2.8.1 (utils/novelaiTokenCalculator.js:22023 initNovelAITokenizer) approximated the 512-token budget with this public T5 tokenizer via Xenova/transformers 2.17.2's AutoTokenizer.from_pretrained("Xenova/t5-small"). This module pins the same tokenizer, upgraded to @huggingface/transformers 4.2.0, loaded from bundled local assets instead of a remote fetch.
